Enrollment fee: $0

How your plan’s pricing works
With a fixed-rate plan, your price per kWh stays the same for the full contract term, even if market prices increase. This protects you from seasonal spikes.
How billing works
You’ll continue to receive your normal monthly electric bill from your utility as you do now. Once service begins, you’ll see CleanChoice Energy listed as your “Supplier”.
How renewable energy works
CleanChoice Energy matches 100% of your electricity usage with Renewable Energy Certificates ("RECs") from wind, solar, and hydro renewable sources. By purchasing and pairing RECs with your electricity, you are using and receiving the benefits of renewable electricity.

Where we source our wind and solar
